title: Repeated table skipper
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, define a partial function on finite bit strings by taking the action skipper for $k$ work tapes and $n+1$ states, iterating that skipper $k+1$ times with each application itself repeated three times, and then repeating this entire procedure $n+1$ times. The function returns the remaining suffix when all applications succeed, and is undefined otherwise.
